elements.evidence: The rendered Article X(b) retains an operative non-solicit that binds both parties: "neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party who is directly involved in the services provided under this Agreement to leave his or her employment". Licensee (Customer) therefore remains restricted; the preferred position (deletion of any Customer-side non-solicit) is not achieved.

Rendered text replaces the one-sided "the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates" with "neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party ... to leave his or her employment with that party", which binds Licensor and Licensee symmetrically.

elements.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: Scope is now limited to "any person employed by the other party who is directly involved in the services provided under this Agreement", replacing the prior "any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates" (all personnel).

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause retains the standing period language: "During the Term of this Agreement and during the twelve (12) month period after the end of a person's involvement". Because the Term limb is preserved and is not tied to the individual's involvement, the covenant continues for the whole Term even where a person's involvement ended more than 12 months earlier (e.g., involvement ends in year 1 of a multi-year Term), so the restriction can run materially longer than 12 months after involvement ends. The anchor is also drafted before the scope limb, leaving "a person's involvement" without an antecedent at the point of use. Repair: delete "During the Term of this Agreement and" and render the period as, e.g., "During the twelve (12) month period after the end of that person's involvement in the services provided under this Agreement, neither party will solicit ...".

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: Second sentence retained verbatim: "Solicit" "shall not mean generally advertising job openings or any activities that constitute follow-up to individuals who respond to job opening advertisements".

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: Same retained definition excludes individuals "who voluntarily initiate employment inquiries", i.e. unsolicited approaches by the person.

elements.element: The restriction does not prohibit hiring.
elements.evidence: The operative prohibition is limited to soliciting a person "to leave his or her employment with that party"; there is no "employ or engage", "hire" or no-hire language anywhere in the rendered paragraph, and "Solicit" is confined to "affirmative recruitment specifically aimed at one or more individuals identified by name, title or affiliation".

reasons: Fallback is incomplete on one element: the duration limb. The edit inserted a 12-month post-involvement tail but left the original "During the Term of this Agreement and" standing limb intact, so the covenant still binds for the entire Term regardless of when a person's involvement ended — that can exceed 12 months after involvement ends, which is exactly the temporal cap the checklist requires.

Actionable repair: strike "During the Term of this Agreement and" and re-anchor the period to the individual, e.g. "During the twelve (12) month period after the end of that person's involvement in the services provided under this Agreement, neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party who is or was directly involved in such services to leave his or her employment with that party." This also cures the forward-referencing "a person's involvement", which currently has no antecedent when first used.

The deterministic check "non-solicit duration ≤ 12 months" reported "number not found"; inspected in substance, the text does state "twelve (12) month", so the mechanical miss is not itself the defect — the defect is the retained Term limb that overrides the 12-month cap.

Mutuality, involved-personnel scope and the absence of any no-hire are properly delivered in operative language; the general-advertising and voluntary-inquiry carve-outs were already present and are retained verbatim, so no new carve-out drafting is needed.

Minimality holds: the change is confined to the first sentence (party direction, scope, duration), no survival tail, expense, procedure or other extras were added, and the carve-out sentence is untouched. Dropping "and/or its Affiliates" narrows the restricted population and is inherent in the scope element rather than an unnecessary deletion.
Intent is preserved: no other allocation, remedy, cross-reference or defined term is disturbed, and no retained sentence contradicts the new mutual formulation.
Because a required fallback element fails on its temporal term, the finding is not position-complete; keep the deviation classification but resubmit with the corrected duration language.
